payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance whose open combat the token joins, when the command names no target; never written
payload.token: uuid — the token of the instance that joins its open combat, once: a token already in the combat is refused, and so is an instance with no open combat
payload.initiative: integer — a PC's initiative, the figure the DM entered: required for a PC, refused for an NPC, which rolls a d20 and adds its DEX modifier (Initiative@1). The newcomer is ranked by initiative, then DEX, then a random draw, after every participant ranked before it or tied with it
payload.shift: uuid — never sent by the DM: the command's own follow-ups, one per participant the newcomer lands ahead of, each moving that entry one rank down, a relative step; refused unless another participant of its combat holds its rank in the queue and the newcomer named under `newcomer` is seated in that combat at or above it
payload.newcomer: uuid — never sent by the DM: with `shift`, the newcomer's initiative entry the step makes room for
